ns2:section.sectionText: *Students must register for both the lecture and one discussion section. The ADV 150 pre-requisite will not be enforced in Spring 2023. Students still must have completed STAT 100 or an equivalent course. Due to preparation in their CS course sequence, students currently in the CS+ADV major ONLY may use completion of MATH 220/221 in place of statistics as the pre-requisite for this course. ADV and Ag Com majors must complete a statistics course and cannot substitute calculus as a pre-requisite to take ADV 281. Due to major demand, it will be determined by Jan. 13 if seats will open to campus.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising or Agricultural Communications or Computer Science & Advertising or Ag Communications-Advertising major(s) or minor(s).
